children: Blue Ridge Bankshares reported a third-quarter 2026 net loss of $4.2 million, or $0.05 per diluted share, compared with a $1.3 million loss in the prior quarter. Net interest margin rose to 3.08% from 2.91%, while adjusted pre-tax earnings increased to $5.3 million. The quarter’s loss included credit-loss provisions and merger-related expenses.
Net interest income was $17.4 million, up from $16.5 million in the second quarter; net interest margin improved 17 basis points to 3.08%.
The company recorded a net loss of $4.2 million, or $0.05 per diluted share, compared with a $1.3 million loss in the prior quarter and net income of $5.6 million a year earlier.
Total provision for credit losses was $8.5 million, compared with $4.1 million in the prior quarter. Third-quarter net loan charge-offs were $10.3 million.
Adjusted pre-tax earnings, a non-GAAP measure, were $5.3 million, compared with $2.9 million in the second quarter. Merger-related expenses were $1.2 million.
Noninterest expense was $15.9 million, approximately unchanged from the prior quarter. Total deposits were $1.81 billion at quarter-end.

Blue Ridge Bankshares and HomeTrust Bancshares entered into a definitive merger agreement. Subject to required approvals and other closing conditions, the transaction is anticipated to close in the first quarter of 2027.
Quarter-end headcount was 255, down from 269 at the end of the second quarter and 311 a year earlier.
The company reported continued progress in loan growth, loan yields, deposit mix and expense discipline during the quarter.

Blue Ridge Bankshares said it charged off a substantial portion of legacy out-of-market loans associated with one borrower in the hydroponic farming business; the remaining balance was approximately $1.5 million at quarter-end.

The company’s residential mortgage program purchases adjustable-rate loans originated generally within its market area, providing a mortgage product to consumer customers. It has also exited indirect fintech lending.
